name: stealth-browser-mcp
description: Stealth browser automation for AI agents over MCP and the Chrome DevTools Protocol: navigation, network hooks, DOM extraction, and pixel-accurate UI cloning.
readme_summary: Stealth Browser MCP is a Python library designed for AI agents to automate browser interactions. It leverages the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) and FastMCP to bypass anti-bot measures like Cloudflare challenges, enabling sophisticated web automation tasks.
key_features: Pixel-accurate element cloning (CSS, DOM, events, assets)
Instant text input and human-like typing
primary_use_case: Enabling AI agents to perform complex and stealthy web automation tasks, including bypassing anti-bot measures and interacting with web pages programmatically.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled digital locksmith, represented as a sleek, modern AI avatar, is meticulously picking the complex lock of a giant, ornate web browser. The browser's lock mechanism is made of intricate digital circuits and glowing data streams, symbolizing anti-bot challenges like Cloudflare. The locksmith uses specialized tools that emit streams of code and network packets, effortlessly bypassing the defenses. Behind the browser, a vast digital landscape of websites is visible, with the locksmith's actions opening pathways. Subtle UI elements showing network traffic and DOM structures float around the scene. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a futuristic, high-tech aesthetic, emphasizing precision and stealth.

name: Alexandrie
description: 📚 The open-source, offline-first Notion, Obsidian & Confluence alternative. Advanced Markdown, multi-tenant teams, OIDC/SSO, and local S3 backups. Deploy in one command.
readme_summary: Alexandrie is a self-hosted, open-source knowledge base and wiki platform that serves as an alternative to Notion, Confluence, and Obsidian. It offers advanced Markdown editing, offline-first capabilities via a PWA, team collaboration features, and enterprise-grade security like OIDC/SSO.
key_features: Advanced Markdown Engine (LaTeX, custom containers, diagrams)
primary_use_case: Self-hosted knowledge management and wiki for individuals and teams.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, organized library where books transform into digital, interconnected nodes of knowledge. A central librarian figure, representing Alexandrie, uses a magical quill that writes in both traditional ink and glowing digital script, seamlessly organizing diverse information streams (represented by flowing ribbons of text and diagrams) into structured shelves and interactive displays. Subtle UI elements like a search bar and a Kanban board are integrated into the library's architecture. The scene is bathed in warm, inviting light, with a clean, modern aesthetic. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration, emphasizing clarity and organization, with a color palette of blues, greens, and warm wood tones.

name: starsift
description: Check whether the accounts behind a GitHub repo's stars look real, now that GitHub hides the stargazer list. Zero-dependency Python CLI with a time-matched control group.
readme_summary: Starsift is a Python CLI tool designed to detect fake GitHub stars by analyzing account behavior. It leverages GH Archive data and compares a repository's stargazers against a control group of randomly selected accounts from the same time period to identify potential star farms, especially after GitHub restricted access to the stargazers list.
key_features: Detects fake GitHub stars by analyzing account behavior.
Uses GH Archive data and a time-matched control group for comparison.
Works even after GitHub restricted access to the stargazers list.
Supports custom sample sizes and alternative control repositories.
Outputs results as JSON for programmatic use.
Provides clear exit codes for farm detection, errors, or clean results.
primary_use_case: To provide developers and security professionals with a tool to audit the authenticity of GitHub repository stars, thereby enhancing supply chain security and trust in open-source projects.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant digital detective, represented as a stylized magnifying glass with glowing circuit patterns, meticulously examining a stream of abstract 'star' icons flowing towards a GitHub repository icon. Some stars are clearly artificial, emitting a faint, glitchy aura, while others are solid and authentic. The detective is highlighting the artificial stars with a beam of light, separating them from the genuine ones. In the background, a subtle timeline graphic shows data being pulled from a cloud labeled 'GH Archive'. The overall mood is one of clarity and security, with a clean, modern aesthetic and a color palette of blues, purples, and subtle greens. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style.

name: parallax
description: Parallax is a distributed model serving framework that lets you build your own AI cluster anywhere
readme_summary: Parallax is a decentralized inference engine that allows users to build AI clusters from distributed nodes with varying configurations. It enables hosting local LLMs on personal devices and supports cross-platform deployment with features like pipeline parallel model sharding and dynamic request scheduling for high performance.
key_features: Host local LLM on personal devices
Paged KV cache management & continuous batching for Mac
Dynamic request scheduling and routing for high performance
GPU backend powered by SGLang and vLLM
Mac backend powered by MLX LM
primary_use_case: Building a distributed AI cluster for model inference across heterogeneous and geographically dispersed nodes, enabling efficient local LLM hosting and deployment.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, conceptual illustration depicting a network of diverse devices (laptops, desktops, servers) seamlessly connected by glowing digital threads, forming a cohesive AI cluster. Each device contributes its processing power, visualized as small, stylized brains or gears, to a central, larger AI entity. Data flows in as raw text scrolls and transforms into insightful, glowing visualizations and generated text outputs. The scene should convey distributed collaboration and intelligent resource pooling, with the repository name 'Parallax' subtly integrated into the network's visual design. The style should be a clean, modern 3D isometric illustration with a bright, optimistic color palette.

name: MLX-GRPO
description: A pure MLX-based training pipeline for fine-tuning LLMs using GRPO on Apple Silicon.
readme_summary: MLX-GRPO is a Python-based training framework for fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) exclusively on Apple Silicon using Apple's MLX framework. It implements Group-based Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for chain-of-thought prompting and supports universal Hugging Face model conversion, dataset preparation, and inference tools.
key_features: Pure MLX Integration on Apple Silicon
GRPO Training Pipeline with multiple reward functions
Easy to Run with config files
primary_use_case: Fine-tuning Large Language Models on Apple Silicon using the GRPO algorithm within a pure MLX environment.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, stylized owl perched on a sleek, modern Apple Silicon chip, meticulously organizing and refining glowing threads of thought (representing LLM outputs). The owl uses its wings to gently guide these threads into a perfectly formed, intricate web of knowledge. Subtle digital particles and faint code snippets float around the scene, hinting at the underlying technology. The background is a clean, minimalist gradient of blues and grays, with the repository name 'MLX-GRPO' subtly etched into a nearby data stream. The overall mood is one of intelligent optimization and focused creation. Style: 3D isometric illustration with soft lighting and clear, defined elements.
